NIST PMI STEP fixtures used as a regression corpus for the analyze pipeline. Six representative files are committed here covering AP203 geometry-only, AP242 editions 1/2/3, a tessellated mesh-only flavour, and a hole-pattern test case from the NIST PMI Sample Models program (https://www.nist.gov/el/systems-integration-division-73400/mbe-pmi-validation-and-conformance-testing). The NIST PMI Sample Models are works of the U.S. Government and are in the public domain. Filenames have been lowercased and spaces replaced with underscores (`AP203 geometry only/nist_ftc_11_asme1_rb.stp` -> `nist_ftc_11_asme1_rb_ap203.stp`); content is unchanged. Files were kept small (<3 MB each, ~7 MB total) so the repo stays lean. Baselines for these fixtures are pinned in `tests/regression/test_nist_corpus.py`.
